newsitem.title: USA: W.W. Grainger buys Acklands Canadian unit for $277 million.
newsitem.headline: W.W. Grainger buys Acklands Canadian unit for $277 million.

text.p: W.W. Grainger Inc. said Wednesday it reached a definitive agreement to buy the Canadian industrial products business of Acklands Ltd. for $277 million.
The Acklands unit, which makes work-related safety products and automotive after-market parts, has annual sales of more than $299 million.
W.W. Grainger, a maker of maintenance and repair products, said the acquisition consists of $135 million in cash and two million shares of W.W. Grainger common stock.
W.W. Grainger's stock was off 87.5 cents at $76.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
